messages:
raj: quick flag — int3 qbringup showing ~7% pass@1 drop on codebench for long code prompts. uploaded candidates to s3://redwood/int3_code_deltas.jsonl

emily: yikes. can you seed a sampled batch for labeling? aim 100 labels + 30 control from golden.

ben: i can do stratified sample by language (py/js), length bucket, and presence of inline ticks. will add dedupe fuzzy_jaccard < 0.8. tag = int3-audit-may2026

tao: also add tokenizer_sensitivity flag to golden meta (high/med/low). recommend running kernel ablation toggling attention_chunk and kv_cache_alignment.

emily: drafted SQL and pushed to queue: select id from prompt_bank where has_code=1 and tokenizer_var>0.1 and fuzzy_jaccard<0.8 order by rand() limit 200;

ops-bot: canary deployed: qbringup/int3-smoke v0.4 -> infra-quant :rocket:

ben: labels enqueued. rubric: PASS, FAIL-TRUNC, FAIL-HALLU, AMBIG. ETA first 20 ~3h.

raj: once we have labels run ai-eval harness baseline vs int3 and save diffs. if many FAIL-TRUNC we consider int4 fallback or kernel tweak.

lina: i'll draft RFC for a token-remap pass in compile pipeline if tokenizer-sensitive. will link audit.

emily: thanks team — ping me when first 30 labels are in and i'll start diff analysis.
